system.description: A sound so wrong it makes the ears bleed, aimed at a foe within 30' that can hear you. The note lingers: if you cast this spell on the same target again before your next Long Rest, you test with Boon.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the foe is Deafened until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.ruin: The note rings in your own skull: you are Deafened until the end of the encounter. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
